fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.examples.molene.pcsm

Class PortableComputerStateModel

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.Model
      • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.AtomicModel
        • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.hioa.models.AtomicHIOA
          • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.examples.molene.pcsm.PortableComputerStateModel
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    VariableDefinitionsAndSharingI, VariableInitialisationI, AtomicModelI, EventsExchangingI, ModelI, java.io.Serializable

    @ModelExternalEvents(imported={InterruptionEvent.class,ResumptionEvent.class,Compressing.class,NotCompressing.class,LowBattery.class})
 @ModelExportedVariable(name="remainingCapacity",
                       type=java.lang.Double.class)
public class PortableComputerStateModel
extends AtomicHIOA
    The class PortableComputerStateModel implements an atomic model for a portable computer in the Molene example.

    Description

    The model has two main functions: keep the current state of the compression mode and simulate the battery level. In order to perform these functions, it must be an HIOA (to have and export a continuous variable for the battery level).

    When modelling the Molene example, the battery level evolution has been assumed to depend upon the compression mode and the availability of the network. Hence, the model imports two events from the WiFi bandwidth model saying when the WiFi is interrupted or not, and it also imports three events coming from the controller telling when to go to a compression mode to another.

    • Imported events: InterruptionEvent, ResumptionEvent, Compressing, NotCompressing, LowBattery
    • Exported events: none
    • Imported variables: none
    • Exported variables: name = remainingCapacity, type = Double

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Invariants

     invariant       true

      • output

        public java.util.ArrayList<EventI> output()
        Description copied from interface: AtomicModelI
        maps the current internal state to the output set; this method is user-model-dependent hence must be implemented by the user for atomic models.

        Description

        Beware that when this method is called, though the simulation time has conceptually reached the time if the next internal event, the value returned by getCurrentStateTime has not yet been updated to that time. Hence the actual current simulation time is given by this.getCurrentStateTime().add(this.getNextTimeAdvance()).

        Contract

         pre     isInitialised()
 pre     getNextTimeAdvance().lessThan(Duration.INFINITY)
 pre     getNextTimeAdvance().equals(getTimeOfNextEvent().subtract(getCurrentStateTime()))
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Returns:
        the corresponding external events or null if none.
        See Also:
        AtomicModelI.output()
